csv_scope_of_work: The City of Albany (City) is soliciting proposals from qualified professional firms (Proposer) to conduct a comprehensive review of the maintenance, repair, and operational needs of City facilities and develop a programmatic approach to maintain operations. This project is expected to serve as a foundational reference for developing a cost-effective and proactive asset management program for facility operations. The selected consultant will develop a list of facility assets, perform condition assessments, prioritize deferred maintenance needs, and develop budgets necessary to maintain facility operations.
